title: The Mountain Chant
note: Navajo text and free translation of the songs of the Mountain Chant from Washington Matthews, "The Mountain Chant: A Navajo Ceremony," Fifth Annual Report of the Bureau of Ethnology (Washington, 1887), as given in Project Gutenberg ebook 20839 (UTF-8 HTML edition); the orthography is Matthews' own, with his characteristic letters kept as printed. Paragraph numbers, the word-by-word notes, Matthews' commentary and footnote markers are omitted. The songs are those printed in the chapters "Songs of sequence" and "Other songs and extracts", together with the two songs whose translations appear in the myth and ceremony chapters.
blurb: Songs of the Navajo Mountain Chant, in the Navajo text as recorded by Washington Matthews in 1884.
author: Anonymous (Navajo)

sections.title: First Song of the First Dancers
sections.text:
Qaniè qaò yaè, qaniè qaò yaè
Qaniè iè oayè oayè.

Qadjinäìa qaò yaè,
Kaç dsil ¢ilhyíli qaò yaè,
‘Çaltsoï tsèë qaò yaè,
Cija cigèlgo qaò yaè.
Náhi ìni èhi oayè, náhi ini èhi oöhè.

Niqoyastcàdje qaò yaè,
Kaç dsil çolíji qaò yaè,
Kini bitsèë qaò yaè,
Cija cigèlgo qaò yaè.
Náhi ìni, etc.

Qadjinäìa qaò yaè,
Kaç dsil litsòï qaò yaè,
Bitselitsòï qaò yaè,
Cija cigèlgo qaò yaè.
Náhi ìni, etc.

Niqoyastcàdje qaò yaè,
Kaç dsil lakàie qaò yaè,
A‘a‘i tsèe qaò yaè,
Cija cigèlgo qaò yaè.
Náhi ìni, etc.

sections.title: Twelfth Song of the Holy Young Men
sections.text:

Tsintsoï ¢ilhyíli inlòooò yaaà yeeè,

sections.title: One of the Awl Songs
sections.text:
Òwe òwe òwe yàni yàï owàn na a [repeat three times],
Òwe òwe ìni áhe oöhè.

sections.text:
